title: Titanium Ballistic Armor Plate
alloyReason: Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5) offers the best balance of high strength (yield >830 MPa), excellent fatigue resistance, and corrosion resistance for precision-machined components. Its strength-to-weight ratio is 45% better than steel, making it the most widely used titanium alloy in aerospace, medical, and industrial applications.
commonFailures: Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86)
Thread damage from improper installation torque exceeding recommended values

faq.q: What is a titanium ballistic armor plate?
faq.a: A titanium ballistic armor plate is a precision-machined armor component used in vehicle/personnel ballistic armor plate. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium ballistic armor plate?
faq.a: Titanium Ballistic Armor Plate is designed for vehicle/personnel ballistic armor plate. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium ballistic armor plate manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Ballistic Armor Plate is manufactured using Closed-die forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium ballistic armor plate?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium ballistic armor plate?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
